associations.rationale: Indecomposability of the antiperiodic module is one ingredient in the counterexample, but it does not alone state failure of Krull-Schmidt.
Indecomposability of the periodic module is another ingredient in the counterexample, not the failure statement itself.
Nonisomorphism of the two indecomposable modules is needed to witness nonuniqueness, but does not by itself assert Krull-Schmidt failure.
The equivalence between the doubled modules supplies the competing decompositions; combined with the other candidates it yields the counterexample, but alone it does not state the source claim.
